title: stenotopsis linearifolia
intro: Stenotopsis linearifolia, commonly known as the "Brazilian rosewood," is a plant species that belongs to the Rutaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Stenotopsis linearifolia include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects, and display antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonoids, flavonoids, and coumarins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
